title.heading:
The Dial:
a wireless knob
title.text:
Flash it, bind it, turn it.
5 steps. A battery is already inside.

labels.title: Round display, 240 x 240
labels.text: It shows what the knob acts on. One button sits under the glass.

labels.title: Knob ring
labels.text: 16 detents a turn, a click for each.

labels.title: USB-C socket
labels.text: For flashing and for the console.

labels.title: Battery inside
labels.text: One LiPo cell of 1,000 mAh or less on the MX1.25 socket. This video takes it as fitted.

say.text: The M 5 stack dial is a wireless knob for the R C bench. This video shows how to flash it, bind it to the panel, and use it. A battery is taken as fitted.
Its round display shows what the knob acts on. The ring around it turns in 16 detents, with a click for each. One button sits under the glass.
The U S B C socket at the back is for flashing and for the console.

labels.title: Flash over USB
labels.text:
Connect the socket to a computer and write the merged image at offset 0x0:
python -m esptool --chip esp32s3 write-flash 0x0 rcbench-dial-merged-<version>.bin
A Dial that runs other firmware: hold the Stamp button while plugging in.

labels.title: NOT BOUND
labels.text: After the restart the Dial shows its name, DIAL- and 4 hex digits, and where to bind it.

say.text: Step 1. Flash the firmware over U S B. Connect the socket to a computer and write the merged image with E-S-P tool. A dial that runs other firmware needs its stamp button held while you plug it in.
After the restart, the dial shows, not bound, and its name.

steps.title: Switch the Dial on
steps.text: Set Dial to ON. The panel starts Bluetooth LE.
steps.say: Step 2. On the panel, open setup, wireless, dial. Set dial to on. The panel starts Bluetooth.

steps.title: Scan, tap, save
steps.text: Scan for Dial scans 10 s. A tap on Bound Dial lists what it found: tap yours, then SAVE.
points: One Dial is bound at a time
steps.say: Scan for dial scans for 10 seconds. A tap on bound dial lists the dials it found. Tap yours, then save. The scan is refused while the bench is armed.

steps.title: What a detent moves
steps.text: 1 % of throttle and 1° of horn angle by default. Each can be 0.5, 1, 2 or 5.
steps.say: Two rows set what a detent moves: 1 percent of throttle, and 1 degree of horn angle, by default.

labels.title: The same readings on both
labels.text: Six readings, a ring for each. While the bench is SAFE a turn moves nothing: ARM on the panel, with its 2 s hold.

labels.title: A detent is 1 % of throttle
labels.text: The panel and the Dial show the same run: throttle, speed, voltage, current and power.

labels.title: PRESS: throttle 0 %
labels.text: A press on the Dial's screen sets the throttle to 0 %. A HOLD of 1 s disarms.

say.text: Step 3. Open motor and E-S-C on the panel. The dial shows the same six readings, each with a ring. While the bench is safe, a turn moves nothing. Arm on the panel, with its 2 second hold.
Armed, each detent moves the throttle by 1 percent. The panel and the dial follow the same run.
A press on the dial's screen sets the throttle to zero. A hold of 1 second disarms.

labels.title: SERVO LIVE: a detent is 1°
labels.text:
The commanded and the measured angle, the pulse and the rail.
PRESS: CENTER. HOLD 1 s: DISARM.

say.text: Step 4. On servo live, each detent moves the horn by 1 degree. A press centres the servo. A hold of 1 second disarms.

labels.title: Not a safety device
labels.text: STOP is on the panel only. ARM, SUPPLY ON, PROG 5V and WRITE stay the panel's 2 s holds: no turn or press switches power on.

labels.title: Link lost while ARMED
labels.text: 500 ms without a packet: LINK LOST, no turn is sent. After 1,000 ms the panel switches the bench SAFE, all outputs off.

labels.title: Forget the panel
labels.text: A 10 s hold of the screen button forgets the bound panel. Protocol version 1 has no pairing and no encryption.

say.text: Step 5. What the dial cannot do. It is not a safety device. Stop is on the panel only, and no turn or press ever switches power on.
If the link is lost while the bench is armed, the dial sends no more turns, and after 1 second the panel switches the bench to safe, with all outputs off.
A hold of 10 seconds forgets the bound panel. There is no pairing and no encryption yet.
